# Berrisol & Illusion Decors — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

> Berrisol & Illusion Decors is a premium stretch ceiling company based in Delhi, India.
> We design, manufacture, and install PVC and fabric stretch ceilings for residential,
> commercial, and institutional spaces across India and internationally.

## About

Berrisol & Illusion Decors (also referred to as Barrisol Ceiling) is a leading stretch
ceiling solutions provider in India. Founded with the vision of bringing European-quality
ceiling systems to Indian homes and businesses, we offer a complete range of stretch
ceiling products — from translucent and printed ceilings to 3D, acoustic, and LED-lit
systems.

We serve clients across Delhi NCR, Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, and across India including
Bangalore, Lucknow, Kanpur, Nagpur, Vadodara, and internationally in Dubai (UAE).

## Products & Services

- Stretch Ceiling Lights — backlit and LED-integrated ceiling systems
- 3D Stretch Ceilings — three-dimensional printed and sculptural ceiling designs
- Printed Stretch Ceilings — custom print-on-demand ceiling surfaces
- Translucent Stretch Ceilings — diffused light ceiling panels
- Transparent Ceiling Solutions — glass-like transparent ceiling systems
- Acoustic Stretch Ceilings — sound-absorbing ceiling panels for studios, offices, hospitals
- Hospital Stretch Ceilings — hygienic, easy-clean ceiling systems for healthcare
- Marble Effect Ceilings — stretch ceilings with marble-like finish
- Custom Lighting Solutions — integrated ceiling lighting design

We also provide city-specific installations across Meerut, Hapur, Bulandshahr, Sonipat,
Panipat, Rohtak, Jhajjar, Rewari, Palwal, Gurugram, Bhiwani, Mahendragarh, Shamli,
Muzaffarnagar, Baghpat, Alwar, Bharatpur, and all Delhi zones (North, South, East, West,
Central, New Delhi).
